content:
If, like me, you have ever lost a few hours down the Wikipedia rabbit hole through the random article feature, the official app now finally offers a way to do the same thing—technically via a widget.

There is finally a button that can take you directly to a random Wikipedia article.

Today's update to the Wikipedia iOS app added an interesting and practical new feature: a "Random Article" widget that can be placed on the home screen of your iPhone or iPad.

This widget comes in both large and medium sizes, and is accompanied by a cute mascot.

Tap the widget and it will take you directly to a completely random Wikipedia article, with "Random Mode" turned on by default.

Without leaving the app, you can just keep tapping the "Random Article" button, and it will keep rolling the dice, taking you deeper and deeper into the maze of random articles.

Have fun, but beware of time slipping away! Earlier this summer, the Wikipedia app already added a history quiz mini-game.

This brand-new widget is now available with today's update to the Wikipedia app for iPhone and iPad.

Make the most of your Apple devices
